harness.measures: The database protocol only: write slot, T1 assembled as production ALL assembles it (IngestionWiring: FootprintWiring.admission over JdbcStorageAdmission(readsFootprint = FootprintWiring.readsFootprint(declarations)) with a declared filesystem, so the one statement also reads the footprint and cohort inputs; seeded trust, observation and watermark rows; the closed beta's 31 cohort shares beside the population (30 participant-sized and 1 legacy, as legacy-share rows: no participant row and no cohort plan, so the cohort pool is read, every copy to a share is priced against its budget, and the pool is not required; unless --no-cohort-shares); probed before every scenario, see t1Probe), T1 (admission lock, one-statement snapshot, reservation insert), the fence rows, T2 (reservations FOR UPDATE, inboxes FOR KEY SHARE, message and attachment rows through JdbcMessageRepository.appendVisible so the ledger triggers run, pg_notify, reservations consumed), retention (ExpireInboxes.sweep hard-deleting one expired inbox per sweep) and compaction on its interval. Uploads are an in-memory stub whose fenced PUT is Stored instantly; T_put and the storage backend are qualified separately (ADR-035 §9a).
harness.lockWaitDefinition: lockWait is StorageProtocolMetrics.lockWait as GuardedStorage reports it: the whole admission call (lock wait, snapshot, decision, insert, commit), NOT the pg_advisory_xact_lock wait alone.
harness.poolLifecycleSource: HikariCP 7.0.2 defaults (maxLifetime 30 min, keepaliveTime 2 min): the ingestion gateway's spring.datasource.hikari sets only maximum-pool-size (application-deployed.yaml, TESTINBOX_DB_POOL_SIZE, default 8) and data-source-properties.ApplicationName (application.yaml); no committed deployment file sets a lifetime

t1Steps.definition: --t1-steps/--focused only, client side, per T1, ms: preLock (call start to lock sent), lockWait (lock sent to returned), hold (lock returned to commit returned: the server's hold to about one round trip), and inside it toSnapshot, snapshot (its round trip), decide (snapshot returned to write sent: row mapping, cohort JSON, decision, insert text), insert (its round trip; it carries the COMMIT since A′), toCommit, commit; then afterCommit. Observed by a JDBC proxy that changes no statement. Never a §11 criterion.

t1Planning.definition: In-lock planning of T1's snapshot over the measured phase, never a §11 criterion. client (--t1-steps/--focused only): snapshot executions per physical connection; one that is among its connection's first prepareThreshold executions plans once inside the lock (coldSnapshotExecutions), and a completed T1 whose snapshot was one is a coldT1 (T1 completion - due), the rest warmT1. server: pg_stat_statements plans and plan time of the snapshot statement (both kinds together; 0 without track_planning). derived: invalidationReplans = server plans - client cold plans; coldPlanCostMs = mean cold snapshot - mean warm snapshot round trip.

sustained2x.threshold: achieved / offered >= 0.995 at 32.0 events/s at concurrency [10, 25, 50, 100] (concurrency 1 is the uncontended baseline, reported only); a window longer than 30 s is also read over a 30 s window, so its terminal-lag allowance stays the 30 s one
sustained2x.detail: worst achieved/offered (read over 30 s where the window is longer) over 4 scenario(s); terminal lag c10=33 ms, c25=28 ms, c50=36 ms, c100=42 ms

t1P99.threshold: T1 p99 <= 50.0 ms (completion - due, schedule lag included) at concurrency [10, 25, 50, 100]; concurrency 1 is reported only

retentionP99VsReference.threshold: retention p99 <= 2.0 x the NO_LOCK reference's retention p99 (ADR-035 §11 mode c, no global ceiling) at the same offered load
retentionP99VsReference.detail: a scenario has no reference run

lockTimeoutRate.threshold: lock_timeout rate < 0.001 of events, every CHOSEN scenario

slotQueueingDeadlineMisses.threshold: 0 events refused for W_slot (StorageUnavailableReason.SLOT_WAIT) across every scenario

otherErrors.threshold: 0 errors other than lock_timeout, deadlock or slot wait, events and retention, across every scenario

retentionStarvedTicks.threshold: 0 retention ticks that found nothing to delete, across every scenario
